notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.28
notes.content:
Some bug fixes regarding sessions and challenges.

[h1]Terraform Patch Notes 1.0.28[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed bug where the profile card did not count challenges as ratings.
[*] Challenges now display local record in level select screen
[*] Fixed bug where your sessions did not increase if cloud saves were enabled.
[/list]

Happy Terraforming!
/Jonas Holgersson

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.25
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 1.0.25[/h1]

CLOUD SAVES!
Please try and start this updated version with the computer with the save file you want to keep. The one you open later will be overwritten with the cloud save if you have cloud saves enabled for the game.

[list]
[*] Cloud saves now working. 
[/list]

As always, please let me know if you have any problems.
Thanks for the support everybody! Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.21
notes.content:
[h1]Terraform Patch Notes 1.0.21[/h1]

Just a quick update to add a requested feature to the planet editor and another fix.
[list]
[*] Added Copy and Paste functionality for the description in the planet editor. Crtl + V will overwrite your description.
[*] Hint on level 149 was too long. Made the font smaller so that all of it can be read.
[/list] 

Please keep letting me know any glitches you find or features you would like to be added. I will try and fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.20
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 1.0.20[/h1]
[list][*] Online highscores on planets will now try and reload if an incorrect value was returned.
[*] Fixed hint on planet 96.
[*] Seed sprite on planet preview images and soil info fixed from first frame to last.

[/list]

I hope you enjoy these updates. This update should be the end of problems with online ratings on planets. Please let me know if you still find errors or odd behavior.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.14
notes.content:
Patch Notes 1.0.14
[list]
[*] When the online record is 0 (unable to get score) you can no longer upload your score as this might overwrite the [i]actual[/i] high score.
[*] Online records are now displayed in the level select screen.
[*] Restart button in the top left corner is now clickable after clearing a level.
[/list]

Some of these changes are only here because of you players reporting wishes and bug reports to me. Thank you for that.
Hope you enjoy the new update and keep letting me know about any problems you encounter. Also please tell me if you have any wishes for the following updates. 

(Still) On my list of features to add: 
[list]
[*] Fix Cloud saves 
[*] Add possibility to rename planets
[*] Ensure that online record is loaded
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.12
notes.content:
The second update since release. This one fixes a few more issues that has come up since launch. 

Patch Notes 1.0.12
[list]
[*] Names of subscribed planets are now properly shown after clearing them
[*] Fixed a bug with skip levels. It is now possible to skip 10 levels.
[*] You now need at least one goal and at least one weather condition in order to save a planet to avoid uploading planets with no goals.
[*] Twitter share link updated to the correct Steam link
[*] Shader crash fixed. It should no longer crash and instead prompt player to update DirectX
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new update and keep letting me know about any problems you encounter. Also please tell me if you have any wishes for the following updates.

On my list of features to add:
Fix Cloud saves
Add possibility to rename planets
